# port49-inventory configuration

`port49-inventory.yaml` configures the inventory service. It is read once at start and strict-decoded; an
unknown key, a removed key or a second document is refused, and an error names the line and the kind of
fault but never a value. Nothing in the file is a secret: secrets are references (`env:NAME` or
`file:/path`), and the keys are files.

Every path must be absolute. Durations need a unit, for example `10m`. Paths below use `[]` for an item of
a list.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `listen` | string | Required. The API address, `host:port`, such as `127.0.0.1:8443` or `:8443`. Mutual TLS on every path. |
| `metrics_listen` | string | Address of `/metrics`, `/healthz` and `/readyz`, plain HTTP, carrying no fleet data. Default `:9050`. |
| `webhook_listen` | string | Address that takes NetBox and Nautobot deliveries, `host:port`, TLS and no client certificate. Set it only if a source has `webhook_secret_ref`, and a source with `webhook_secret_ref` needs it. Unset means no webhook. |
| `webhook_tls_cert_file` | string | Certificate for the webhook listener. Default: the API's. Set with `webhook_tls_key_file`. |
| `webhook_tls_key_file` | string | Private key for the webhook listener. Set with `webhook_tls_cert_file`. |
| `tls_cert_file` | string | Required. The API's server certificate. |
| `tls_key_file` | string | Required. The API's private key. It is read through the key-file check: not a symlink, owned by the service user or root, no group or other mode bits, at most 1 MiB. Keep it in a directory only its owner can write. |
| `client_ca_file` | string | Required. The CA that issues the certificates of readers and syncers. |
| `readers` | list of string | Identities that may read the bundle: `user:<email>` in lowercase or a certificate's URI SAN such as `spiffe://...`. `readers` or `syncers` must name someone. |
| `syncers` | list of string | Identities that may read the bundle and start a sync (`POST /v1/sync`). Same form as `readers`. |
| `signing_key_file` | string | Required. The private key that signs the bundle. |
| `verify_key_files` | list of string | Further public keys the service accepts for its own state directory and mirror: the old signing key's during a rotation, so the sequence and the bound survive it. The service's own public key is always accepted. Read once, at start, so a change needs a restart: SIGHUP starts a sync and does not re-read it. |
| `sync_timeout` | duration | How long one sync may run before it is cut off. Default `5m`; `10s` to `1h`. |
| `policy_file` | string | Required. The policy file the service validates a bundle against before serving it. |
| `state_dir` | string | Required. Where the service keeps its state. Must not contain or be inside `mirror_dir`. |
| `mirror_dir` | string | Optional. A separate copy of the state, read at a cold start when `state_dir` has none. Must be outside `state_dir`. |
| `interval` | duration | How often each source is synced unless it sets its own. Default `10m`; `1m` to `24h`. |

## `safety`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `safety.max_removed_percent` | integer | The largest share of the fleet, `0` to `100`, a sync may remove before it is refused. Default `10`. A source without its own bound takes this one. |

## `sync`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sync.[].name` | string | Required. The source's name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, unique. At least one source is required. |
| `sync.[].type` | string | Required. `file`, `netbox` or `nautobot`. |
| `sync.[].path` | string | `file` only, required: the absolute path of the inventory file the source reads. |
| `sync.[].interval` | duration | How often this source is synced. Default: the top-level `interval`; `1m` to `24h`. |
| `sync.[].safety.max_removed_percent` | integer | This source's own removal bound, `0` to `100`. Default: the top-level bound. |
| `sync.[].url` | string | `netbox` and `nautobot` only, required: the product's base URL. |
| `sync.[].ca_file` | string | `netbox` and `nautobot` only, required: an absolute path to the CA bundle that issues the source's certificate (the host's own bundle file for a public one). |
| `sync.[].token_secret_ref` | secret reference | `netbox` and `nautobot` only, required: where the API token is read from, `env:NAME` or `file:/absolute/path`. One to 512 printable characters with no space. |
| `sync.[].webhook_secret_ref` | secret reference | `netbox` and `nautobot` only: where the secret that signs this source's webhook deliveries is read from. 32 to 255 printable characters with no space. Needs `webhook_listen`. |
| `sync.[].profile` | string | `netbox` and `nautobot` only: the product profile to read with. Must be one the build knows for the type; the error lists them. |
| `sync.[].api` | string | `netbox` and `nautobot` only: `auto` (default), `graphql` or `rest`. `rest` cannot give interface addresses. |
| `sync.[].page_size` | integer | `netbox` and `nautobot` only: devices per request, `1` to `1000`. Default `500`. |
| `sync.[].filter.status` | string or list of string | Statuses kept, a name or a list; an empty list is refused. Default `[active]`. |
| `sync.[].filter.tags` | list of string | Only devices with these tags are kept. |
| `sync.[].filter.has_primary_ip` | boolean | Set `true` to keep only devices that have a primary IP. |
| `sync.[].map` | map of string | Attribute name to the path in the product's record it is read from, for example `site: site.slug`. Must include `platform`. An attribute name is lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, and not `name`. |
| `sync.[].addresses.primary` | boolean | Whether the device's primary IP is an address. Default `true`. |
| `sync.[].addresses.interfaces` | list of string | Interface names whose addresses are also device addresses. Not with `all_interfaces`. |
| `sync.[].addresses.all_interfaces` | boolean | Set `true` to take the addresses of every interface. Not with `interfaces`. At least one of `primary`, `interfaces` or `all_interfaces` must give an address. |
| `sync.[].platform_aliases` | map of string | Maps the product's platform slug to the platform name the policy uses, `slug: platform_name`. Slugs are compared in lowercase; two entries alike in lowercase are refused. |
